book.name: Roma
book.title: Ukanikorongi Ubana a Asu u Aza a Roma

content: Zuwa utoku u vunu u pana kayanyan

A̱tsu aza ɗa upityanangu u tsunu wa̱ri n ugbami, she tsu yain ahankuri n Atoni a Asheku a ɗa upityanangu u le bawu u gbamai. Tsu ma̱tsa̱ tsu zuwa le a pana kayanyan n u ɗa tsa zuwa kaci ka tsunu tsu pana kayanyan koshi.
Tsu yawunsa a ili iꞌya i lobono le, aku tsu ɓa̱nga̱ le a uyan ili iꞌya a ka pana kayanyan.
Ko Kawauwi u yan ili iꞌya eyi wa pana kayanyan utyoku u ne wa. Shegai tyoku ɗa Tagara̱da u Kashila̱ u danai, “Aza ɗa a wisha vu mpa dem a wishai.”

Gba̱ ili iꞌya a korongi a Tagara̱da u Kashila̱, korongu ɗa a korongi iꞌya tsa̱ra̱ a wenishike tsu. Tagara̱da u Kashila̱ u tsu na̱ka̱ tsu ta̱ akawunki, na̱ ndishi n katakasuvu, tsa̱ra̱ tsu yain n uzuwa u uma.
Kashila̱ ka ka tsu na̱ka̱ tsu akawunki na̱ ndishi n katakasuvu. Kavasu ka va̱ ka u zuwa i dusuku ndishi n shinga n atoku a ɗe a asuvu a utono u Kawauwi u ɗe.
Aku gba̱ ɗe i ɓolomgbono a asu u te n kala̱ga̱tsu ka te, i yain icikpali n una̱ka̱ tsupige ubana a asu Kashila̱ Tata u Asheku a tsunu Yesu Kawauwi.
Kadyanshi ka Shinga a asu u ama gba̱
Wushai atoku a ɗe tyoku ɗa Kawauwi ka wusha ɗa̱. Pini nala, ɗa Kashila̱ ka wusha tsupige.
N tonuko ɗa̱ Kawauwi ka woko ta̱ kagbashi ka aza a Yahuda, tsa̱ra̱ u wenike an kazuwamgbani ka Kashila̱ ka yankai akaya a le icun kau‑kau mayun ɗa.
Kpam u tuwa̱ ta̱ tsa̱ra̱ Awulawa a na̱ka̱ Kashila̱ tsupige adama a iyali iꞌya u pana le. Dere tyoku ɗa Tagara̱da u Kashila̱ u danai:

content.text: “Ma cikpala vu ta̱ asuvu a Awulawa.
Ma shipa ta̱ ishipa i icikpali i kala ka vunu.”

content: Tagara̱da u Kashila̱ u doku ta̱ u danai:

content.text: kaɓolo n ama a ne aza a Yahuda.”

content: Tagara̱da u Kashila̱ u doku ta̱ dem u danai:

content.text: “Cikpalai Magono ma Zuba gba̱ ɗe Awulawa.
Cikpala ni, gba̱ ɗe ama a likimba.”

content: Aku Ishaya matsumate u danai:

content.text: “Uza roku asuvu a kuwa ku Dawuda Magono wa tuwa̱ ta̱,
wa lya ta̱ tsugono a kaci ka Awulawa gba̱,
kpam a ka zuwa ta̱ uma u le ara ne.”

content: Kavasu ka va̱ ka Kashila̱, uza ɗa u tsu na̱ka̱ uzuwa u uma, u shaɗangu ɗa̱ n upana kayanyan ushani na̱ ndishi n shinga a asu u upityanangu n eyi. Aku uzuwa u uma u ɗe u lyai kapala n ugbonguro a ucira u Kulu Keri.
Bulus dansai a kaci ka manyan ma ne
Ama a va̱, n reve ta̱ iꞌa̱ ta̱ ushaɗangi n ukuna u shinga. N reve ta̱ iꞌa̱ ta̱ n ureve u ɗa u gain i yain n u ɗa, n reve ta̱ kpam ya fuɗa ta̱ ya wenishike atoku a ɗe.
Shegai n koronku ɗa̱ ta̱ karara a ukuna u ili iꞌya ma ciga ɗa̱ i ciɓa. N yan ta̱ ili i nala yi adama a ɗa Kashila̱ ka yanka mu ta̱ ukuna u shinga,

kpam u na̱ka̱ mu manyan ma uwoko kagbashi ka Yesu Kawauwi a asu u Awulawa. N gbashika ta̱ Kashila̱ a asu u uwenishike Kadyanshi ka Shinga ka ne. N woko ta̱ yavu kaɗara̱kpi† tsa̱ra̱ Awulawa a woko uɗara̱kpa u ɗa Kashila̱ ka wusha; wata, uɗara̱kpa u ɗa Kulu Keri ku gonukoi uwulukpi.
Adama a nala, n za̱nga̱na̱ ta̱ adama a ili iꞌya n yankai Kashila̱ a asu u Yesu Kawauwi.
Ma dansa ukuna u roku wa, she ili iꞌya Kawauwi ka yain a asu u va̱ an n tonoi n Awulawa a pana̱ka Kashila̱ adama a ili iꞌya n danai n iꞌya n yain.

Kpam a pana̱ka ta̱ Kashila̱ adama a ucira u iryoci n ikunesavu iꞌya a wenishei, kpam n adama a ucira u Kulu Keri. N yan ta̱ kuɓari ku Kadyanshi ka Shinga a Urishelima† hal gba̱ ukyawan a kaɓon ka Ilirikun, kpam nala n kotsoi kuɓari ki ko nte wa.
N tsu ciga ta̱ n yain kuɓari ku Kadyanshi ka Shinga a asu u ɗa bawu kotsu ama a panai ukuna u Kawauwi, kpaci ma ciga n mai a asu u ɗa uza roku u gita̱i wa.
Tyoku ɗa Tagara̱da u Kashila̱ u danai ɗa:

content.text: “Aza ɗa bawu kotsu a tonukoi ukuna u ne, a ka wene ta̱,
aza ɗa kpam bawu a panai ukuna u ne, a ka reve ta̱.”

content: Bulus wa ciga u ba u kondo Roma
Manyan ma na mi ma tsu rongo mu ta̱ uka̱ngusu n ba n kondo ɗa̱.
Gogo‑na n kotso ɗe manyan ma va̱ gba̱ a asu u na vi. Ma̱ri ma ciga ɗa̱ ta̱ uwene caupa.
Mpa pini a afoɓi tsa̱ra̱ n bana a kaɓon ka Asa̱baniya, aꞌayin a ɗa baci ma yan nwalu mi, ma ɓatsa ta̱ a Roma. Aꞌayin a ɗa baci n panai kayanyan ka ndishi n a̱ɗa̱ kenu, i ɓa̱nga̱ mu n ka̱na̱ ure.
Shegai kahu n wene ɗa̱ vi, she n wala ve a Urishelima tsa̱ra̱ n banka Atoni a ɗa aꞌa̱ri ɗe kune.
Aꞌuwa a Atoni a ɗa aꞌa̱ri a kaɓon ka Masidaniya n ka Akataya a na̱ka̱ ɗe ikebe yaa tsa̱ra̱ a ɓa̱nga̱ ama a Kashila̱ aza a unambi a ɗa aꞌa̱ri a Urishelima.
A pana ta̱ kayanyan ka uyan nala, shegai wa̱ ta̱ dem yavu a tsupa kutan, kpaci Awulawa a wusha ta̱ ili i shinga i kulu ku Kashila̱ a akere a aza a Yahuda.
N kotso le baci una̱ka̱ kune ku na ki, ma kondo ɗa̱ ta̱ aku n wura ubana a Asa̱baniya.
N reve ta̱ n rawa baci ara ɗe, Kawauwi ka zuwuka mu ta̱ una̱ u shinga u pige tsa̱ra̱ n zuwuka ɗa̱.

Ama a va̱, ma folo ɗa̱ a asuvu a kala ka Asheku a tsunu Yesu Kawauwi i ɓolomgbono na̱ mpa a manyan ma va̱ a asu u uyan kavasu ubana a asu u Kashila̱ adama a va̱. Yanyi nala adama a uciga u ɗe ara va̱ u ɗa Kulu Keri ku na̱ka̱ ɗa̱.

Yanyi kavasu tsa̱ra̱ a aza ɗa aꞌa̱ri a kaɓon ka Yahuda, aza ɗa bawu a wushuki n Yesu Kawauwi, kotsu a ne mu usa̱n wa. Yanyi dem kavasu adama a ɗa ama a Kashila̱ a ɗa aꞌa̱ri a Urishelima a yain maza̱nga̱ adama a ili iꞌya n yanka le tsa̱ra̱ n ɓa̱nga̱ le.
Kashila̱ ka wushunku mu baci nala, ma tuwa̱ ta̱ ara ɗe n maza̱nga̱, kpam ukondo u va̱ ara ɗe wa zuwa mu ta̱ n pana kayanyan kpam u woko mu uwunvuga.
Gogo‑na a̱sa̱ka̱ Kashila̱, uza ɗa u na̱ka̱ tsu ndishi n shinga, u rongo n a̱ɗa̱ gba̱ ɗe. Ami.
